query:
INSERT INTO bookings (
  officeId, serviceId, userId, bookingType, status, paymentStatus,
  preferredDate, scheduledDate, price, createdAt
) VALUES
-- Completed bookings (past dates)
((SELECT id FROM sanad_offices WHERE slug = 'muscat-business-center' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM sanad_office_services WHERE serviceName = 'Company Registration' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM users WHERE openId = 'customer_001' LIMIT 1),
 'service', 'completed', 'paid',
 DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 DAY), DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 DAY),
 500.000, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY)),

((SELECT id FROM sanad_offices WHERE slug = 'salalah-legal-docs' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM sanad_office_services WHERE serviceName = 'Document Translation' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM users WHERE openId = 'customer_002' LIMIT 1),
 'service', 'completed', 'paid',
 DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 DAY), DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 DAY),
 50.000, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)),

-- Confirmed bookings (upcoming)
((SELECT id FROM sanad_offices WHERE slug = 'muscat-business-center' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM sanad_office_services WHERE serviceName = 'Trade License' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM users WHERE openId = 'customer_001' LIMIT 1),
 'service', 'confirmed', 'paid',
 DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 DAY), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 DAY),
 300.000, NOW()),

-- Pending bookings
((SELECT id FROM sanad_offices WHERE slug = 'salalah-legal-docs' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM sanad_office_services WHERE serviceName = 'Notarization Service' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM users WHERE openId = 'customer_002' LIMIT 1),
 'service', 'pending', 'unpaid',
 DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 DAY), NULL,
 75.000, NOW()),

-- In progress booking
((SELECT id FROM sanad_offices WHERE slug = 'muscat-business-center' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM sanad_office_services WHERE serviceName = 'Company Registration' LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT id FROM users WHERE openId = 'customer_001' LIMIT 1),
 'service', 'in_progress', 'paid',
 NOW(), NOW(),
 500.000, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 DAY))
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status=VALUES(status);
